description: This file defines a PHP Trait called IndexingStatisticsTrait, which provides functionality for tracking and reporting search/indexing statistics such as counts of indexed modules, records, fields, and removed records. It includes methods for retrieving these statistics, generating a report, and resetting counters. The trait is intended to be used within an indexing context, likely in conjunction with an 'AbstractIndexer' class.

methods.name: getRemovedRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of records that have been removed during indexing.

methods.name: getIndexedRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of records (beans) that have been indexed.

methods.name: getIndexedFieldsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of record fields that have been indexed.

methods.name: getIndexedModulesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of modules that have been indexed.

methods.name: statistics
methods.description: Reports on indexing statistics such as number of modules, records, fields, elapsed time, and estimates time for further indexing based on current speed.

methods.name: resetCounts
methods.description: Resets all indexing counters to zero.
